name: campaign-when-no-microbench-isolates-it
note: a conjecture about an interaction with no isolating microbenchmark is planned as one campaign experiment

input.conjecture: Fusing the mean and variance passes into one traversal helps this operator even though each pass alone is already coalesced.
input.expected_observation: attainment rises by at least the noise floor in one experiment

conjecture.expected_observation: attainment rises by at least the noise floor in one experiment
conjecture.statement: Fusing the mean and variance passes into one traversal helps this operator even though each pass alone is already coalesced.

notes: an unverified conjecture may inspire hypotheses and cannot be grounds for verification
keep it in kb/conjectures/ until the plan has run; promotion is a replay-gated move

cases: the narrowest shape range the conjecture claims
experiments.why_minimal: one campaign experiment on the cheapest dev operator is enough to falsify it

outcome_table.open: the experiment could not be made valid: not_implemented, correctness failed, or the counters were absent
outcome_table.promoted: the observation appears and the metric moves as predicted: attainment rises by at least the noise floor in one experiment
outcome_table.refuted: the experiment is valid and the observation does not appear

plan.promotion_path: promotion makes it a candidate rule with this experiment as its single confirmation; it still cannot be used as evidence to verify anything until a second operator confirms it
